row.notes: TRACK_DATA getter (120 calls from 105 functions, 10 of them in .data1). Walks the track data sets at system+0x68..+0x70 (0x30 stride) and takes the first whose +0x20 mode, +0x24 season and +0x28 weekend format masks hold the query bits (query bytes: [0] mode stat_id bit, [1] mode used, [2] season statId bit, [3] season used, [4] format bit <2 (1 = sprint), [5] format used; with its used byte set, a bit index of 32 or more for [0] or [2], or 2 or more for [4], throws std::out_of_range "invalid bitset position" (0x142e60f1c, 0x142e60f21) once the set walk reaches that test, so an empty table, or no set passing the earlier fields, returns 0 instead); returns the TrackDataTrack at set+0x08 items[track_ref[1]]+0x08 (16-byte items), else the first non-null track of that same set; 0 when no set matches. track_ref is a TrackDataRecord, of which only the u8 at +1 is read; it comes from system+0x28 at 0x140b78095 and from [[X+0xf40]+0x1a8]+0x30 at 0x14036fe7e and 0x1407a176c. Callers pass, among others, CareerEntity+0xf58 (0x14036fe70) or component+0x278 -> +0xf58 (0x140b78053). L2 from decomp; verified V1153.
